proof_body:
by
  intro V P _ _ _ _ t i j k hij hik hjk
  have hb : Sbtw ℝ (t.points j) (t.touchpoint ∅ i) (t.points k) :=
    t.sbtw_touchpoint_empty hij.symm hjk hik
  have ht := t.isTangentAt_insphere_touchpoint i
  have mj : t.points j ∈ affineSpan ℝ (Set.range (t.faceOpposite i).points) :=
    t.points_mem_affineSpan_faceOpposite.2 hij.symm
  have mk : t.points k ∈ affineSpan ℝ (Set.range (t.faceOpposite i).points) :=
    t.points_mem_affineSpan_faceOpposite.2 hik.symm
  have h1' : inner ℝ (t.incenter -ᵥ t.touchpoint ∅ i) (t.points j -ᵥ t.touchpoint ∅ i) = 0 := by
    have h1 : inner ℝ (t.points j -ᵥ t.touchpoint ∅ i) (t.touchpoint ∅ i -ᵥ t.incenter) = 0 :=
      ht.inner_left_eq_zero_of_mem mj
    rw [← neg_vsub_eq_vsub_rev t.incenter, inner_neg_right, neg_eq_zero, real_inner_comm] at h1
    exact h1
  have h2' : inner ℝ (t.incenter -ᵥ t.touchpoint ∅ i) (t.points k -ᵥ t.touchpoint ∅ i) = 0 := by
    have h1 : inner ℝ (t.points k -ᵥ t.touchpoint ∅ i) (t.touchpoint ∅ i -ᵥ t.incenter) = 0 :=
      ht.inner_left_eq_zero_of_mem mk
    rw [← neg_vsub_eq_vsub_rev t.incenter, inner_neg_right, neg_eq_zero, real_inner_comm] at h1
    exact h1
  have hang : EuclideanGeometry.angle t.incenter (t.points i) (t.touchpoint ∅ k) =
      EuclideanGeometry.angle t.incenter (t.points i) (t.touchpoint ∅ j) :=
    Affine.Simplex.angle_incenter_touchpoint_eq
      (t.points_mem_affineSpan_faceOpposite.2 hik) (t.points_mem_affineSpan_faceOpposite.2 hij)
  have s1 : Sbtw ℝ (t.points i) (t.touchpoint ∅ k) (t.points j) :=
    t.sbtw_touchpoint_empty hik hij hjk.symm
  have s2 : Sbtw ℝ (t.points i) (t.touchpoint ∅ j) (t.points k) :=
    t.sbtw_touchpoint_empty hij hik hjk
  refine ⟨t.dist_incenter i, hb, ?_, ?_⟩
  · rw [← vsub_sub_vsub_cancel_right (t.points j) (t.points k) (t.touchpoint ∅ i), inner_sub_right,
      h1', h2', sub_zero]
  · rw [s1.angle_eq_right, s2.angle_eq_right] at hang
    rw [EuclideanGeometry.angle_comm, hang]
target_source: ∀ (V P : Type*) [NormedAddCommGroup V] [InnerProductSpace ℝ V] [MetricSpace P] [NormedAddTorsor V P] (t : Affine.Triangle ℝ P) (i j k : Fin 3), i ≠ j → i ≠ k → j ≠ k → dist t.incenter (t.touchpoint ∅ i) = t.inradius ∧ Sbtw ℝ (t.points j) (t.touchpoint ∅ i) (t.points k) ∧ inner ℝ (t.incenter -ᵥ t.touchpoint ∅ i) (t.points j -ᵥ t.points k) = 0 ∧ EuclideanGeometry.angle (t.points j) (t.points i) t.incenter = EuclideanGeometry.angle t.incenter (t.points i) (t.points k)
